name: Asgard.net
summary: Brisbane dialup/ISDN + hosting ISP; still Asgard.net-branded to Feb 2003, rebranded Instant Communications by 2006 (dialup + ADSL + SDSL + hosting), absorbed into EFTel ~2007.

events.details: ASGARD COMPUTING PTY LTD ACN 078294130 incorporated 22 Apr 1997; earliest website capture 9 Jan 1998.

refs.label: Asgard Computing Pty Ltd ACN 078294130 — incorporated 22 Apr 1997

events.details: Absorbed into EFTel (via Instant Communications); asgard.net.au served an Instant Communications page that then sat frozen (identical capture) from 2007 through 2023. Proposal's c. 2007 promoted with the Aug 2006 EFTel acquisition now hard-dated; the frozen Instant page persisted on the domain to Sep 2009 (asgard.net.au is an unrelated property group today). rebranded 'Instant Communications' by Jun 2005; EFTel acquired Instant Aug 2006; frozen Instant retail page still served to Sep 2009.

refs.label: asgard.net.au already rebranded to Instant Communications by 29 Jun 2005 — end of the Asgard.net brand
Hard acquisition date: EFTel bought Instant Communication on 14 Aug 2006 — the ISP's independent existence ended there
